description: Remediate configuration drift across a fleet of 8000 Linux hosts where 15% of hosts have drifted from the desired state (Puppet/Catalog). The remediation must follow: detect drift (run Puppet in noop mode or Ansible check mode to identify drifted hosts), classify drift (categorize by drift type: file content, package version, service state), auto-remediate drifted hosts in staged batches (apply correct config, verify each batch), and generate a drift report (host inventory, drift summary, remediation status). A rollback plan must exist for auto-remediation (revert config if remediation causes service failure). Risk factors: remediation can restart services causing brief downtime, some drift is intentional (manual hotfixes that shouldn't be reverted), and fleet scale. Tools available: Puppet, Ansible, Rundeck, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK (for drift reporting).
